prose: Basis: the Wall Street Journal blocks automated fetching (HTTP 403), so this note rests on Techmeme's account. Nearly a quarter of Anthropic's S-1 - 94 pages - is dedicated to risk factors. Among them: a warning that the scale of harm from a catastrophic AI incident might leave the company unable to obtain insurance. It is an unusually blunt disclosure for a document whose purpose is to attract capital, and it sets the prospectus apart from the standard boilerplate of tech listings.

The filing warns a catastrophic AI incident could make insurance unobtainable
